title: Citizen Inquiry Agent - Instantiation Config
description: Input form schema used by WSO2 Agent Manager to instantiate a Citizen Inquiry Agent for a specific department.

DEPARTMENT_NAME.title: Department Name
DEPARTMENT_NAME.description: Official department name shown to citizens.

DEPARTMENT_CODE.title: Department Code
DEPARTMENT_CODE.description: Short department prefix used for identifiers and instance naming.

KB_NAMESPACE.title: Knowledge Base Namespace
KB_NAMESPACE.description: KB namespace to search for this department's knowledge base.

WELCOME_MESSAGE.title: Welcome Message
WELCOME_MESSAGE.description: Default opening greeting shown in the chat UI.
examples: Hello, I'm the Permits & Licensing virtual assistant. How can I help you today?

OFFICE_HOURS_INFO.title: Office Hours
examples: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 4:15 PM (excluding public holidays)

MODEL_TEMPERATURE.title: Model Temperature
MODEL_TEMPERATURE.description: Execution temperature. Kept low for strict factual accuracy.
